question: Why is the electrostatic potential constant throughout the volume of a charged conductor?

options.A: Because the electric field inside is zero, meaning no work is done in moving a charge.
options.B: Because the charge density is uniform throughout the volume.
options.C: Because the electric field is perpendicular to the surface.
options.D: Because the conductor is made of metal.
